App.Title: RDA Data Recovery Wizard
Home.Title: Where did you lose your files?
Home.Subtitle: Pick the disk or drive where the data was lost. Lost files, deleted partitions and formatted drives are all recoverable from here.
Home.Loading.Headline: Reading the disk information…
Home.Loading.Detail: The engine is enumerating disks and volumes. This usually takes a few seconds.
Home.Error.Headline: The disk list could not be read
Home.NoTarget: Nothing selected yet — pick a disk or drive above
ScanConfig.Title: How thoroughly should we search?
ScanConfig.QuickDetail: Fast scan of the file tables — best when the disk just lost files.
ScanConfig.DeepDetail: Thorough scan without raw carving — good when the filesystem is damaged but present.
ScanConfig.DeepCarveDetail: Thorough scan plus signature search for files the filesystem no longer references — the most complete, takes longest.
ScanConfig.CategoriesDetail: All types are recovered either way — these chips shape the results view right after the scan.
ScanProgress.Title: Scanning for your files…
ScanProgress.Subtitle: Keep the disk connected. You can keep using your computer — the scan runs in the engine and does not modify the source disk.
ScanProgress.NoPause: Pausing is not available: the engine has no save-mid-scan. Cancelling discards what this run has found so far.
ScanProgress.Failed.Headline: The scan stopped
Recovery.Title: Where should the files go?
Recovery.Subtitle: Choose a destination on a DIFFERENT disk than the one you are recovering from — writing onto the source would destroy recoverable data.
Recovery.Refused.Headline: Recovery to this destination is refused:
Health.Title: Disk health
Health.Subtitle: Read-only diagnostics straight from the drive. Nothing here is modified — health is informational.
Repair.Title: Volume repair (RawFixer)
Repair.Subtitle: This repairs damaged filesystem structures ON THE DISK ITSELF. It writes to the source media — a separate safety standard from recovery. An undo log is always written first.

About.Title: RDA Data Recovery Wizard
